findings.issue: Admin dashboard reads `dashboard?.stats` but getDashboard returns a flat object with no `stats` key. All eight stat cards display '—'.
findings.fix: Change `const stats = dashboard?.stats || {}` to `const stats = dashboard || {}` and align key names: use `todayAppointments` (server key) instead of `todayBookings`, and source `confirmedBookings`, `inProgressBookings`, and `completedToday` from the `reports` object already fetched.

findings.issue: Recent-bookings table reads `dashboard?.recentBookings` which does not exist in the getDashboard response; the table is always empty.
findings.fix: Read `reports.recentBookings` (already fetched from getReports) instead of `dashboard.recentBookings`.

findings.issue: No GET /partner/jobs/:id endpoint exists. PartnerJobPage fetches the entire job list and scans it client-side for the requested ID.
findings.fix: Add `router.get('/jobs/:bookingId', protect, requirePartner, getJobById)` and a controller that calls `Booking.findOne({ _id: bookingId, partnerId: req.user._id })`.

findings.issue: Photo upload calls `URL.createObjectURL()` and sends the resulting `blob:` URL to the backend, where it is persisted in MongoDB. Blob URLs are tab-scoped and become dead references after the session ends.
findings.fix: Implement a real upload endpoint (multer + disk or S3 presigned URL) before enabling the photo feature, or disable/hide the UI until the upload path is ready.

findings.issue: `ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS` allows `confirmed → in_progress` without a partnerId, so an admin can complete a booking that was never assigned to a partner, leaving `partnerId: null` on the completed record.
findings.fix: Either document this as an intentional manual-dispatch path or add a guard: if the target status is `in_progress` or `completed`, verify `booking.partnerId` is set.

findings.issue: `registerPartner` returns `{ success, token, user, data: { profile } }` — token and user at root level — while every other endpoint uses `{ success, data: { ... } }`. The frontend works around it but the contract is inconsistent.
findings.fix: Reshape the response to `{ success: true, token, data: { user: safeUser, profile } }` to match the auth controller pattern, and update `PartnerRegisterPage` accordingly.

findings.issue: Manifest references `/icons/icon-192.png` and `/icons/icon-512.png` which may not exist under `web/public/icons/`. Missing icon files suppress the PWA install prompt silently.
findings.fix: Confirm the icon files exist at those paths, or update the manifest to reference paths that do exist.

findings.issue: The server never emits `new:request` to the `partners` room. PartnerDashboardPage listens for this event but it is never fired, so partners do not receive real-time new-request notifications.
findings.fix: In `bookingController.js` where a booking transitions to `searching_partner`, call `emitToAll('partners', 'new:request', { bookingId })` (or add a broadcast helper) after saving.
